proposed.reason: §7 names the SignedTerms members and the amendment adds rail and feePayer; the types and the ShieldedSource / ShieldedDestination / ShieldedCorridor / ShieldedFeeBreakdown nesting are fixed here.

Primary type ShieldedPreviewV1 under domain name "Xochi Shielded Preview" (version "1", the §7 chainId/salt scheme): the terms minus intentId, quoteId, operationId, sourceAuthorizationDigest and reservationId. Never signed.
collectBefore and settlementServiceDeadline uint64 Unix seconds; policyRevision uint32; bps uint16; decimals uint8; ids, assetId and recipientBindingId strings; sourceAuthorizationDigest bytes32.

The narrowest shape matching Riddler FeePolicy's layered breakdown, amounts in SOURCE base units (an exact-output fee is added to the source pull). totalFee = gasFloor + the four layers; totalBps = the four rates. Tier, asset class, total_usd and the surplus share are not signing values.

base = ceil(amount * sourceUnits / destinationUnits); each layer floor(base * bps / 10000); source.amount = base + totalFee; refundAmount = source.amount (design A refunds in full). Each preview vector carries its inputs.

The §6/§7 identity fields as typed members: the recipient class pin is outside (decided 2026-10-24), the exact Aztec SDK version inside; rounding literal "ceil-source-units"; provenance, redemption and finality rules as strings.
The EIP-712 digest of the §7 RecipientBinding whose shared members are the terms' own; only nonce and challengeExpiry come from the binding.
